description_image_agent: Describe a picture and the agent draws it. If there isn’t enough detail, it asks questions first.
description_music_visualiser: 166 lo-fi tracks from a public-domain collection, each visualised as it plays across thirteen scenes.
description_tree_of_life: Every living thing on one globe, drawn from the Open Tree of Life. Start at the origin of life and walk to any species alive today; every organism along the way has a portrait.
